study: Blinded nine-realization eBOSS matched-count angular and coarse radial selection control
matched_density_rule: For each cap, redshift slice, and tracer independently, define target count as the smallest full count among observed randoms and all nine fixed mock randoms; draw two fixed-seed exact-count multinomial replicates from each already audited binned sky map, without changing the underlying masks.
metrics: Four-bin unweighted redshift fractions and total-variation distance between each mock and observed random catalogue per tracer/cap
Full-resolution normalized tracer sky-map total-variation distance per z bin
Exact-count multinomial resample observed-vs-mock joint support Jaccard at all fixed thresholds for both replicate indices
Observed-within-observed and mock-within-mock resample joint support Jaccard at the same matched count and threshold
Per-tracer matched-count resample sky-map total-variation distance and within-catalogue finite-count reference
interpretation: Exploratory, data-blind finite-random selection diagnostic only; binned pixel counts do not encode continuous angular vetoes and multinomial replicates are correlated through their parent full catalogues. Four-bin counts do not establish fine weighted n(z). No p-value, sigma, exact angular mask, or covariance is estimated.
limitations: Mock shard arrays have unweighted sky counts, not weighted effective sky maps
Existing mock source records retain four broad z-bin counts but not sub-bin weighted n(z)
Resampling an empirical sky map cannot distinguish catalogue-dependent systematic geometry from its inherited pixel probabilities
Physical analysis must use mask documentation and actual pair-level common footprint before unblinding
